body:
## Why

This is the Travel-Plan-Permission child of the fleet campaign in `stranske/Workflows#3399`. The Gate's `Report Gate commit status` step calls `github.rest.repos.createCommitStatus` at `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml:380-389`. Its catch at `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml:391-397` tolerates only a rate-limit 403 and rethrows every other 403. A pull request opened from a fork receives a read-only `GITHUB_TOKEN`, so `Resource not accessible by integration` currently fails the summary job after the Gate has already computed its verdict. This is a current break for fork contributions, confirmed by the 2026-09-24 remote fleet scan in Workflows #3399: Travel-Plan-Permission still lacks `isForkPullRequest` while the source-of-truth guard is already merged upstream.

## Scope

Align this repository-owned, `create_only` Gate copy with the already-merged Workflows fork-token guard. Preserve the existing Travel-Plan-Permission Gate shape: it has the commit-status write but no preceding consolidated-summary-comment write, so this child changes only the status step and adds a focused executable regression test.

## Non-Goals

- Do not change `pull_request_target`, workflow permissions, token loading, branch protection, or the Gate's coverage/runtime policy.
- Do not broaden tolerance to every 403; a same-repository 403 must remain a hard failure.
- Do not alter the existing rate-limit path or claim this makes a missing `Gate / gate` status satisfiable under branch protection.
- Do not edit Workflows or another consumer in this child; Workflows #3399 retains the remaining fleet campaign.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: adding a predicate without exercising the actual extracted GitHub Script, or adding a test that does not prove both fork and same-repository behavior, fails this issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] In `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml`, classify a fork from `context.payload.pull_request.head.repo.full_name` and `.base.repo.full_name`, then tolerate only a non-rate-limit 403 on that fork by logging the computed Gate verdict and writing it to `core.summary`.
- [ ] Create `tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py` to extract the real `Report Gate commit status` JavaScript from `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` and execute it under Node with stubbed `github`, `context`, and `core` objects.
- [ ] In `tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py`, cover fork read-only 403, same-repository 403, fork rate-limit 403, non-403 failure, and successful status-write behavior, including the warning and job-summary verdict evidence.
- [ ] Capture the deliberate-break transcript from the named pytest gate in the PR body, then restore the exact implementation before requesting review.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q` exits 0 and executes the workflow step's extracted JavaScript under Node; the output is captured in the PR body.
- [ ] The named tests prove a fork 403 does not throw and writes the computed `success` verdict, description, and head SHA to `core.summary`, while a same-repository 403 and a non-403 error still throw.
- [ ] The named tests prove the existing rate-limit 403 remains tolerated through its own warning path and a successful status write remains silent.
- [ ] **Deliberate-break gate:** temporarily remove only the `readOnlyForkToken` handling from `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml`; `pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py::test_fork_read_only_403_does_not_fail_the_gate -q` must fail because the 403 is rethrown. Revert that break, rerun the same test, and capture failing and passing output in the PR body.
- [ ] A post-change remote read of `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` on the PR head contains `isForkPullRequest`; the PR body records the exact base and head SHAs.

## Implementation Notes

- Parent campaign: `stranske/Workflows#3399`; merged source reference: `stranske/Workflows#3398` and `tests/workflows/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py` on Workflows main.
- Current verified base: Travel-Plan-Permission `origin/main` at `e9dd35a`; the affected status step is `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml:361-398`.
- Keep the branch and PR limited to this repository. The PR should close only this child issue and reference Workflows #3399 without closing it.
title: [P1] Fork PR Gate should preserve verdict when commit-status token is read-only
